notes: forth is the English phrasal verb's own particle inside ποιήσατε's unit; no Greek preposition or preverb stands to answer to it.
τῆς is unrepresented because the ASV writes of repentance with no determiner, so rule 21's determinerless clause keeps of with the noun.
The ASV's marginal Or, your repentance is a rendering note and does not bear on the article's status.
